battle.name: 第三次反法同盟
battle.brief: 第三次反法同盟期間，法軍在巴伐利亞韋廷根與奧地利軍交火，此役屬於一八〇三年秋季戰役的一部分。法軍以突然襲擊迫使聯軍退卻，顯示歐洲中部兵力調度與戰場地形的重要性。火繩槍（Matchlock musket）為十六世紀已列裝的步兵火器，但不是此役交戰各方的主力制式裝備。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 年代界線必須先校正：1803年5月18日英國向法國遞交開戰文書，恢復因《亞眠條約》而中斷的英法戰爭；正式以第三次反法同盟號召的歐洲聯盟則在1805年形成。因此本文把1803年列為序幕，戰役實錄一路寫到1806年普魯士軍隊在耶拿與奧爾施泰特崩潰。英國方面是英國皇家海軍及英軍，1805年又有俄羅斯帝國、奧地利帝國、瑞典王國與那不勒斯王國加入；法國方面有法軍、荷蘭巴達維亞共和國和西班牙盟軍，普魯士起初按兵不動，1806年才正式投入。戰線包括北海、地中海、英吉利海峽、加勒比海、錫蘭與歐洲大陸，殖民地攻防、封鎖奪航和會戰結果都構成同一場戰爭的不同層次。
countriesEn: The chronological boundary must first be corrected: on 18 May 1803 Britain delivered a declaration of war to France, resuming the Anglo-French conflict interrupted by the Treaty of Amiens. The European alliance calling itself the Third Coalition was not formed until 1805. This account therefore treats 1803 as the prelude and follows the fighting through the collapse of the Prussian army at Jena and Auerstedt in 1806. On the British side were the Royal Navy and British army; Russia, Austria, Sweden, and Naples joined in 1805. France had the French army, the Batavian Republic, and Spanish allies, while Prussia remained cautious until entering the war in 1806. The theaters included the North Sea, the Mediterranean, the English Channel, the Caribbean, Ceylon, and continental Europe. Colonial operations, maritime blockades, control of sea routes, and continental battle results were different layers of the same war.
people: 英方決策由小威廉·皮特掌理，外相霍克斯伯里奉命送出開戰文書，國王喬治三世批准動員；地中海方面以基思海軍上將統籌英軍，納爾遜在搜索法國艦隊時屢次接戰，卡爾德於1803年7月指揮菲尼斯特雷角海戰，拉圖什－特雷維爾則率法國艦隊應戰。1805年維倫紐夫接掌法西聯合艦隊，最後在特拉法加面對納爾遜。法國陸軍最高統帥是仍以第一執政身分作戰的拿破崙，他身邊有達武、蘇爾特、拉納、內伊、穆拉與近衛軍指揮官；奧方由馬克統率主力，庫圖佐夫率俄軍往維也納方向接應，巴格拉季昂指揮聯軍右翼，皇帝 Francis II 與沙皇 Alexander I 均在軍中。1806年普魯士方面則由 Frederick William III、施泰因與不倫瑞克公爵統兵，布呂歇爾負責掩護撤退。拿破崙在奧斯特里茨獲勝的同一天完成皇帝加冕。
peopleEn: British policy was directed by William Pitt the Younger, while Foreign Secretary Lord Hawkesbury delivered the declaration of war with the approval of King George III. In the Mediterranean, Admiral Lord Keith coordinated the British forces, Horatio Nelson repeatedly sought contact with the French fleet, and Robert Calder commanded the engagement off Cape Finisterre in July 1803 against Latouche-Tréville. In 1805, Villeneuve took command of the combined French and Spanish fleet and finally met Nelson at Trafalgar. Napoleon Bonaparte led the French army while still First Consul, with Davout, Soult, Lannes, Ney, Murat, and the Guard under his command. Austria was represented by Mack, who commanded the main army, and Kutuzov, who marched the Russians toward Vienna, with Bagration commanding the Allied right wing. Emperor Francis II and Tsar Alexander I were both present. In 1806, Frederick William III, Stein, and the Duke of Brunswick commanded the Prussians, while Blücher covered the withdrawal. Napoleon received the imperial crown on the same day as his victory at Austerlitz.
kits: 本篇裝備以1803年為上限。英軍步兵主要使用1762式燧發滑膛步槍，通稱Brown Bess，配1797式插座刺刀；法軍使用1777式步槍及其1794年改短槍管型；奧軍為1798式步兵槍，普軍則是1801式步兵槍。野戰砲包括英軍6磅與9磅砲、法軍Gribeauval制式4磅、8磅及12磅砲，另有奧軍3磅與6磅野戰砲。步兵腰盒攜帶黑火藥與鉛彈構成的定裝紙包，英軍腰盒通常以六十發為攜行基準，炮隊另備實心球、葡萄彈和罐彈，並由彈藥車補充備用火藥。英軍步兵已配1800式高筒帽，騎兵使用燧發手槍、彎刀或軍刀。海戰主力是74炮戰列艦，也有80炮及100炮一級戰列艦；英軍短程卡隆炮自1778年起列裝，適合近距封鎖火力。營內還配置野戰炊具、工具車、飲水桶、備用馬匹、浮橋器材與輜重車，物件皆為1803年以前已實際列裝的型號。
kitsEn: The equipment ceiling for this account is 1803. British infantry principally carried the Pattern 1762 flintlock musket, commonly called Brown Bess, with the Pattern 1797 socket bayonet. French troops used the Model 1777 musket and its shortened Model 1794 variant; Austrian troops carried the Model 1798 infantry musket, and the Prussians used the Model 1801 infantry musket. Field artillery included British 6- and 9-pounder guns, French 4-, 8-, and 12-pounder Gribeauval pieces, and Austrian 3- and 6-pounder field guns. Infantry cartridge boxes held paper cartridges containing black powder and ball, with the British box normally based on sixty carried rounds. Artillery batteries also carried round shot, grape, and canister, while ammunition wagons replenished reserve powder. British infantry had already received the Pattern 1800 stovepipe shako, and cavalrymen carried flintlock pistols, sabres, or swords. Naval line-of-battle strength centered on 74-gun ships, with 80- and 100-gun first-rates also serving. The British carronade, fielded from 1778, provided short-range firepower. Field kitchens, tool carts, water barrels, spare horses, pontoon equipment, and baggage wagons completed the column. Every type named here had actually been fielded by 1803.
tactics: 1803年的英法交戰首先是一場海權較量：英國以遠洋封鎖、護航與登陸火力切斷法國及盟國的航路， colonies在登陸前先遭艦炮壓制，避免法軍主力在歐洲正面消耗；基思維持對土倫的海上監視，卡爾德雖在菲尼斯特雷角迫使法艦退讓，卻未完成追擊毀滅。1805年海戰轉為明確的縱列戰：英軍以27艘戰列艦迎戰33艘法艦與18艘西班牙戰列艦，納爾遜把突擊主力分成迎風縱隊與下風縱隊，讓快速分隊先穿過法國縱列的後方；大西洋長浪拖慢法國先頭縱列，後方轉向保護主力時隊形再被打斷。陸戰方面，奧軍以步兵師、騎兵旅和炮兵團在烏爾姆集中，卻因糧秣不足及縱隊分離被法軍各軍團切斷；法軍則以可獨立行軍的軍團沿平行道路進逼，通信一斷便能集中優勢兵力。奧斯特里茨前，聯軍原打算左翼南移，奪取普拉藏高地並迫使法軍中央讓步；實際移動延誤後，蘇爾特等軍先占高地，達武在北面拖住巴格拉季昂，聯軍中央與翼側遂被分隔。1806年法軍利用內陸道路與缺口穿過普軍尚未接合的縱隊，在耶拿正面壓倒一支普軍，在奧爾施泰特擊潰不倫瑞克公爵所部主力。浮橋、彈藥車、麵粉與飼料補給線決定了行軍速度；英軍封鎖則依靠直布羅陀與馬耳他基地、煤炭、飲水和定期換防維持。
tacticsEn: The Anglo-French conflict of 1803 first presented as a contest of sea power. Britain used distant blockades, convoy protection, and naval gunfire to sever French and allied routes. Colonial positions were reduced by shipboard fire before landing detachments advanced, sparing the British army a direct collision with the main French force in Europe. Keith watched Toulon, and although Calder forced the French fleet to withdraw at Cape Finisterre, no decisive pursuit followed. The naval battle of 1805 became a defined battle in line. Nelson's 27 ships of the line opposed 33 French and 18 Spanish ships of the line. He divided the main attacking force into windward and lee columns, allowing the faster division to pass behind the French line while the long Atlantic swell slowed the French van. As the French rear turned to protect its center, its formation fractured. On land, the Austrian army concentrated infantry divisions, cavalry brigades, and artillery around Ulm, but inadequate supply and separated columns allowed the French corps to cut it apart. The French marched in independent corps along parallel roads, preserving the ability to concentrate against a single enemy force. Before Austerlitz, the Allied plan was to move the left wing south, seize the Pratzen Heights, and force the French center to give ground. The movement was delayed, permitting Soult and other French formations to take the heights while Davout held Bagration in the north. The Allied center and flank were then separated. In 1806, French corps used inland roads and gaps between separated Prussian columns. They destroyed one Prussian army in the attack at Jena and overwhelmed the Duke of Brunswick at Auerstedt. Pontoon bridges, ammunition wagons, flour convoys, and fodder trains governed marching speed, while the British blockade depended on Gibraltar and Malta for coal, water, and regular relief.
data: 序幕與遠洋戰線：1803年2月18日，錫蘭的荷屬守軍投降；2月23日，英軍奪回聖露西亞；4月25日，英軍占領托巴哥；同年稍後又取回聖文森特。5月18日英國向法國遞交開戰文書，5月20日法國作出宣戰。英國隨後在加勒比海與歐洲港口實施封鎖，7月22日卡爾德在菲尼斯特雷角遇上拉圖什－特雷維爾率領的法國艦隊，雙方交戰後各自脫離，英軍未把法國主力消滅。正式反法同盟階段：1805年4月8日英國、瑞典與那不勒斯結盟，俄羅斯和奧地利於8月加入；拿破崙在8月底越過萊茵河，向巴伐利亞與烏爾姆推進。馬克率領的奧軍集中於烏爾姆，糧秣與情報不足使各縱隊失去聯繫；10月16日埃爾興根之戰後，10月20日烏爾姆守軍投降。海上方面，維倫紐夫率領的法西聯合艦隊於10月21日在菲尼斯特雷角被納爾遜截住，多艘戰列艦被擊毀、俘獲或迫使投降。陸上方面，庫圖佐夫帶領俄軍自維也納經克雷姆斯往布勞瑙推進，得知法軍已越過多瑙河後轉向回援；11月13日法軍進入維也納，月底占據普雷斯堡。12月2日，拿破崙在奧斯特里茨利用普拉藏高地的側翼攻勢擊破奧俄聯軍，12月26日《普雷斯堡和約》簽訂。1806年10月14日，耶拿與奧爾施泰特兩役摧毀普軍主力，11月23日法軍進入柏林，第三次反法同盟的軍事階段至此結束；外交收束則是1807年7月7日的《提爾西特條約》。
dataEn: The prelude and overseas operations began with the Dutch garrison in Ceylon capitulating on 18 February 1803. British forces retook Saint Lucia on 23 February, occupied Tobago on 25 April, and recovered Saint Vincent later that year. Britain delivered its declaration of war on 18 May, and France answered on 20 May. The British then blockaded French and allied ports and shipping routes in the Caribbean and Europe. On 22 July, Calder encountered Latouche-Tréville's French fleet off Cape Finisterre. Both sides disengaged, and the British failed to destroy the French main force. The formal coalition phase began on 8 April 1805, when Britain, Sweden, and Naples formed an alliance; Russia and Austria joined in August. Napoleon crossed the Rhine late in August and advanced into Bavaria and Ulm. Mack's Austrian army was concentrated around Ulm, but shortages of supply and poor information left its columns disconnected. After the Battle of Elchingen on 16 October, the garrison surrendered at Ulm on 20 October. At sea, Villeneuve's combined French and Spanish fleet was intercepted by Nelson off Cape Finisterre on 21 October, losing several ships of the line to destruction, capture, or forced surrender. On land, Kutuzov marched the Russians from Vienna through Krems toward Braunau, then turned back after learning that the French had crossed the Danube. The French entered Vienna on 13 November and occupied Pressburg at the end of the month. On 2 December, Napoleon used the flank attack through the Pratzen Heights to defeat the Austrian-Russian army at Austerlitz. The Peace of Pressburg followed on 26 December. On 14 October 1806, Jena and Auerstedt destroyed the main Prussian forces, and the French entered Berlin on 23 November, bringing the military phase of the Third Coalition to an end. Its diplomatic conclusion came with the Treaty of Tilsit on 7 July 1807.
cause: 第三次反法同盟的序幕源於《亞眠條約》無法形成穩定秩序。1802年3月25日簽訂的條約雖結束公開戰爭，卻對馬耳他、埃及撤軍、殖民地歸還和英國海軍地位留下多項執行爭議；英國依條約繼續控制錫蘭與千里達，又以安全理由佔有馬耳他，法國則要求重審殖民地安排並把馬耳他交還騎士團，談判因而破裂。拿破崙不能接受英國藉補貼和海軍控制歐洲同盟維持有利均勢，1798年英國介入荷蘭與1799年介入俄羅斯聯軍的經驗，使他視英法衝突為攸關法國安全與歐洲秩序的長期鬥爭。1805年聯盟形成時，奧地利因法國在萊茵、義大利與巴伐利亞的擴張感到威脅，俄羅斯因法國可能改變歐洲均勢而要求制衡，英國則以補貼和海上封鎖支援奧俄。普魯士擔心立即參戰會遭敗績，因此延後出兵；拿破崙先以軍團集中各個擊破奧軍，再迫使奧地利退出，也讓俄國失去可信盟友。
causeEn: The prelude to the Third Coalition arose from the inability of the Treaty of Amiens to create a stable settlement. The treaty signed on 25 March 1802 ended open warfare, yet left disputes over Malta, the evacuation of Egypt, the return of colonies, and the position of British sea power. Britain continued to hold Ceylon and Trinidad under the settlement and occupied Malta on security grounds. France demanded a revision of the colonial arrangements and the return of Malta to the Knights of Malta, and negotiations broke down. Napoleon could not accept a British system of subsidies and naval control that maintained a favorable balance among European states. British intervention in the Netherlands in 1798 and in the Russian coalition of 1799 had shown how maritime power could support a continental coalition. When the alliance formed in 1805, Austria feared French expansion along the Rhine, in Italy, and in Bavaria. Russia demanded a counterweight to French predominance, while Britain supported Austria and Russia with subsidies and maritime pressure. Prussia feared an early defeat and delayed its entry. Napoleon sought to divide the coalition by concentrating against the Austrian army first, forcing Austria out, and leaving Russia without a dependable partner.
impact: 1803年的影響首先出現在海上與殖民地，而不在歐洲會戰。英國重新控制聖露西亞、托巴哥、聖文森特及錫蘭等據點，千里達與馬耳他也繼續握在英方；皇家海軍以封鎖切斷法國的海上補給，卻未能消滅法國地中海艦隊，反而迫使法國把分散航線和艦隊集中問題帶入1805年。特拉法加證明英軍能以分縱隊穿陣、縮短射擊距離並切斷敵方後方，但法國仍保有沿岸防禦、造船能力與戰後重建資源，海上優勢並不等於永久解除法國海上威脅。陸戰方面，烏爾姆與奧斯特里茨暴露出奧軍補給、通訊和縱隊指揮的缺陷，也顯示法軍以獨立軍團集中兵力能迅速形成局部優勢。戰略結果雖不對稱，第三次同盟的崩潰卻使奧地利退出、俄國收兵、普魯士受創，法國得以把勢力伸入萊茵與北義大利。英國贏得海上主動權，卻仍缺少足以單獨迫使法國大陸軍隊讓步的力量。
impactEn: The first effects of 1803 appeared at sea and in the colonies rather than on a major European battlefield. Britain regained Saint Lucia, Tobago, Saint Vincent, and Ceylon, while Trinidad and Malta remained in British hands. The Royal Navy blockaded French supply routes but did not destroy the French Mediterranean fleet. Instead, the problem of dispersed routes and fleet concentration carried directly into 1805. Trafalgar demonstrated that the British could penetrate a line with divided columns, shorten firing distance, and isolate an enemy rear, but France retained coastal defenses, shipbuilding resources, and the ability to rebuild. The land campaigns showed the consequences of poor Austrian supply, communication, and column control at Ulm, while also displaying the speed with which independent French corps could concentrate for a local advantage. The results were uneven, but the coalition's collapse forced Austria out, drew Russia home, and left Prussia badly defeated. France extended its position along the Rhine and into northern Italy. Britain gained maritime initiative but still lacked a means of compelling the French continental army to yield without continental allies.
result: 各戰區的結局並不相同。1803年階段，英國保住海上封鎖優勢及錫蘭、千里達、馬耳他等據點，法國則保存了地中海艦隊主力；1805年特拉法加海戰中，維倫紐夫被俘，Bucentaure投降，Achille爆炸，Neptuno與Santísima Trinidad被俘，Waldegrave? No. 這個不要. 法西聯合艦隊失去作為整體行動的力量，短期內無法形成入侵英國的海上集結。歐洲方面，烏爾姆使奧地利主力投降，奧斯特里茨使奧俄會戰兵力崩潰，《普雷斯堡和約》迫使奧地利割讓威尼斯地區、蒂羅爾等領土並退出戰局；1806年耶拿與奧爾施泰特再使普軍主力失去作戰能力，法軍進入柏林，普魯士也走向退出。1807年的《提爾西特條約》完成俄普與法國之間的外交收束，但英國並未因此立即獲得歐洲和平。總體而言，第三次反法同盟在海陸兩線均告失敗：法國取得歐洲大陸的戰略主動權，英國保有海上主動權及若干永久或長期據點，卻未能阻止法國重整軍力。
resultEn: The outcomes differed by theater. In the opening phase of 1803, Britain preserved its blockade advantage and retained Ceylon, Trinidad, Malta, and other positions, while France preserved the main force of its Mediterranean fleet. At Trafalgar in 1805, Villeneuve was captured, Bucentaure surrendered, Achille exploded, and Neptuno and Santísima Trinidad entered British custody. The combined French and Spanish fleet lost the ability to operate as a coherent force and could not shortly assemble a seaborne threat against Britain. In continental Europe, Ulm forced the Austrian main army to surrender, and Austerlitz broke the Austrian-Russian field army. The Peace of Pressburg compelled Austria to cede Venetia, the Tyrol, and other territories and to leave the war. Jena and Auerstedt in 1806 then destroyed the Prussian army's main capacity to fight, the French entered Berlin, and Prussia moved toward withdrawal. The Treaty of Tilsit in 1807 completed the diplomatic settlement between France, Russia, and Prussia, but it did not immediately give Britain a European peace. The Third Coalition therefore failed on both land and sea. France gained strategic initiative on the continent, while Britain retained maritime initiative and several permanent or long-term possessions but could not prevent France from rebuilding its military power.
